validation_published_transients.source: Yan et al. 2023, ApJS 269, 43 (arXiv:2307.07579), Table 4/5; positions shifted by the measured frame offset

frame_offset_arcsec.from: Ep2-Ep1 F356W difference peaks of D21-W1, D21-W3, D21-S1, SN01 (derived)

missed.D21-W1, D21-W2, D21-W3, D21-S1, D21-S2,: caustic-crossing stars at F356W 27.1-28.6 on arcs: forced 0.15 arcsec apertures at the corrected positions give |sigma| <= 3.3 (calibrated); below the 5 sigma threshold
missed.SN02: on its host nucleus; nearest grid position 0.34 arcsec away (no catalog entry of its own); at its corrected position F115W +5.3, F150W +6.2 sigma, so a position set problem, not depth

validation_published_transients.before_fixes: 0 of 8: per-band recentring in epoch 1 moved the LW apertures of SN01 onto a neighbour, and its F115W fade / LW brightening has mixed sign
